seo.title: Locations: Verde Law Immigration Attorneys
seo.description: Miami-based immigration firm serving clients in all 50 states. Virtual consultations available anywhere in the U.S.

locations.title: Based in Miami. Fighting nationwide.
locations.subtitle: Our office is in Coral Way. Our clients are everywhere, from Krome detention to immigration courts in Chicago, New York, Los Angeles, and every circuit in between.

office.title: Come in person, or don't. Both work.

national.title: All 50 states. One firm.
national.body: Immigration law is federal. It doesn't matter which state you live in. A Florida-licensed attorney can represent you in any immigration court, USCIS office, or federal appellate circuit in the country. We appear in person when required, remotely when allowed, and we handle the logistics so you don't have to.

virtual.title: Meet us from anywhere.
virtual.body: Most of our consultations happen by phone, WhatsApp, or video. You don't need to travel to Miami, and you don't need to take a day off work. Pick the channel that works for you. We're there.

phone.title: Phone
phone.desc: Call (305) 786-3003. A real person answers in English or Spanish, day or night.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp
whatsapp.desc: Message us at any hour. We reply as soon as we're back in the office, usually within minutes during the day.

video.title: Video call
video.desc: Zoom, Google Meet, or FaceTime. We'll send the link after you book.
